thread:
Lydia (Leadership): Quick follow-up from today's All-Hands security segment. We had several customer asks about SOC2/ISO timelines, BYOK/HSM, VPC private connectivity, and audit log exports. Can owners post short timelines and action items here so CS can share? :point_down:

Asha (Security): Short Qs first: 1) SOC2 Type II target? 2) Are Hosted + Dedicated both in initial scope?

Lydia (Leadership): Target = SOC2 Type II. Scope = Hosted + Dedicated initially; Private will be supported via a customer playbook. Owner for compliance program: Priya. Target milestone: controls map by end of Q2, audit window Q4 2025.

Priya (Compliance): Confirmed. I'll publish a controls-to-evidence checklist by 2025-04-12 and a Private-deployment playbook by 2025-05-05.

Ben (Infra): VPC / PrivateLink: work in next sprint. ETA for PrivateLink GA and control-plane private peering: mid-Q3 2025. We'll add an audit log streaming option to customer buckets as part of that work.

Tom (SRE): Hosted default audit-log retention today is 90 days. We'll expose 365-day retention as an enterprise option with export.

Asha (Security): KMS BYOK: plan is alpha for Dedicated in Q2 2025, GA with HSM-backed keys across Hosted + Dedicated by Q4 2025. Rotation APIs + manual workflows supported. Owners: Ben + Asha.

security-bot: SOC2 roadmap doc uploaded: https://internal.redwood/compliance/soc2-plan-2478901234 (access may be restricted).

Ben (Infra): Example console template for audit exports we'll ship:
```yaml
audit_export:
  destination: s3://<customer-bucket>
  format: jsonl
  batch_interval_seconds: 60
  retention_days: 365
```

Priya (Compliance): Action items summary: 1) Publish controls checklist by 2025-04-12. 2) Deliver Private playbook by 2025-05-05. 3) Audit export UI & templates by 2025-06-01. 4) Schedule office hours for detailed Q&A next Wed 10am PT.

Lydia (Leadership): Thanks, team. I'll share this summary with CS and partners. If anything slips, update thread. Closing for now. :thumbsup:
